examples.title: Surface Probe
examples.summary: Creates a native wgpu surface, selects an adapter, configures presentation, and exposes backend diagnostics.

examples.title: Resize & Fullscreen
examples.summary: Demonstrates robust surface reconfiguration, minimized-window handling, fullscreen, and resize lifecycle.

examples.title: WGSL Shader
examples.summary: Builds the minimal native shader pipeline with WGSL, uniforms, a render loop, and telemetry.

examples.title: Tauri Controls
examples.summary: Connects an HTML control surface to native Rust/wgpu renderer state through Tauri commands.

examples.title: Image Texture
examples.summary: Loads image pixels into native GPU textures and samples them in a WGSL render pipeline.

examples.title: Ping-Pong Feedback
examples.summary: Uses two HDR render textures for persistent native feedback, transforms, decay, color accumulation, and corruption.

examples.title: Multipass Render Graph
examples.summary: Makes pass ordering, intermediate textures, and multi-stage native rendering explicit.

examples.title: High-Resolution Lab
examples.summary: Explores internal render sizes, high-DPI presentation, performance, and 4K–8K working targets.

examples.title: Backend Lab
examples.summary: Inspects and selects Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, or GL backends and reports adapter limits.

examples.title: Compute Particles
examples.summary: Updates a large particle system in compute shaders and renders directly from GPU-managed buffers.

examples.title: 3D Particle Volume
examples.summary: Extends compute particles into a genuine XYZ volume with depth, perspective, and 3D motion.

examples.title: Volumetric Raymarcher
examples.summary: Ray-marches four procedural 3D scenes with fog, shadows, ambient occlusion, and high-resolution targets.

examples.title: Compute Fluid Feedback
examples.summary: Runs velocity advection, vorticity, divergence, pressure solve, dye advection, and feedback entirely on the GPU.

examples.title: Camera Input
examples.summary: Introduces live camera frames as a native-wgpu texture source with capture diagnostics.

examples.title: Native Webcam Texture
examples.summary: Uses a macOS-native capture bridge to feed webcam frames into persistent GPU textures efficiently.

examples.title: Native Video Decoder + Effect UI
examples.summary: Uses native FFmpeg decoding, latest-frame BGRA handoff, GPU texture effects, and owned playback state.

examples.title: Native Recording Pipeline
examples.summary: Demonstrates GPU readback, bounded frame handoff, FFmpeg encoding, and recording-state diagnostics.

examples.title: MIDI Parameter Registry
examples.summary: Maps native MIDI events into a stable parameter registry that can drive renderer state and external patches.

examples.title: OSC Network Control
examples.summary: Routes OSC messages from Max, TouchOSC, Pure Data, or network peers into native renderer parameters.

examples.title: Gesture Field
examples.summary: Retains pointer, touch, and pen samples and routes them into particle, fluid, depth-ring, and raymarch fields.

examples.title: Multi-Input Compositor
examples.summary: Combines multiple media and generated sources, transport, audio analysis, layers, and GPU compositing.

examples.title: glTF Scene Loader
examples.summary: Loads glTF/GLB geometry, materials, textures, depth, lighting, camera controls, and scene diagnostics.

examples.title: Skeletal Pose Lab
examples.summary: Explores joints, skinning, poses, animation playback, lighting, and bone-overlay diagnostics.

examples.title: Morph Target Lab
examples.summary: Blends shared-topology target shapes in WGSL using normalized, additive, and sequential modes.

examples.title: Mesh Feedback Deformer
examples.summary: Uses ping-pong storage buffers for persistent GPU vertex deformation and compute-generated normals.

examples.title: Ultra-Resolution Export
examples.summary: Renders independent HD/4K/6K/8K tiles, reads them back safely, assembles pixels, and exports PNG.
